config.selection_rationale: Equal mean of four projection SSIMs on all ten validation patients; broad layer objective fixed before training.
config.inference_description: Euler8, global velocity stitching with positive separable Hann, 50% overlap; float32 state, final-only clamp
config.validation_prediction_retention: Full-resolution metrics, projections and B-scan scores retained; no validation 3D files.
config.formal_test_prediction_retention: Frozen validation-best, all50 full-resolution float32 predictions retained.
config.precision_comparison: New A/B share float32/TF32-allowed profile. Historical exp018 used TF32-disabled float32.
